RSL Music Journey — UX v2 (per critique)
Flow: HOME branches to BUILD MY NIGHT / WHAT'S GOOD NOW / BROWSE ARTISTS. BUILD MY NIGHT opens on MY TASTE (edit taste, then trip details) → JOURNEY. WHAT'S GOOD NOW goes straight to a JOURNEY-style feed using your saved taste. BROWSE ARTISTS → ARTIST DETAIL. JOURNEY → Save Journey.
Two separate badge systems now, used consistently everywhere an artist appears: ROLE (⭐ Strong match / 🧭 Discovery / 🧪 Wildcard — a recommendation judgment) and SIGNAL (🟢 Established / 🟡 Emerging / 🟣 Unknown — a fact about the artist, independent of role). "Why" reasons are provenance-tagged: check = you selected it, chain = derived from a taste-reference artist, clock = system inference.

HOME
Mood tiles live on Home (quick-toggle) with real icons — no more ambiguous glyphs. Browse Artists + Saved promoted to visible actions.

BUILD MY NIGHT — step 2
Shows a compact, editable YOUR TASTE summary instead of re-asking. Explicitly still collects duration, night, start time, location, adventure level.

WHAT'S GOOD NOW
Same card language as Journey. Demonstrates role ≠ signal: an Established artist can still be just a Discovery, not a Strong Match.

BROWSE ARTISTS
Every row: genre/style, performance type, signal badge, geography where known. Filter chips by signal tier.

MY TASTE — step 1 of Build My Night (also reachable to edit anytime)
Favorite artists split RSL ARTIST (playing 2026, teal) vs TASTE REFERENCE (dashed, not in the lineup — e.g. Bonobo, Carl Cox).

JOURNEY
Every stop shows role badge + signal badge + genre + performance type + location + a provenance-tagged reason. Last stop reads STRONG MATCH · FINALE.

ARTIST DETAIL
Geography, about, notable info, links (only what's real), sources/verified date. Built to hold richer bios later without a redesign.
